rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for making someone suddenly feel scared or startled.

example.english: Every time they suddenly appear behind me, they frighten me.
example.traditional: 佢哋一喺我背後突然出現，就嚇親我。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 hai2 ngo5 bui3 hau6 dat6 jin4 ceot1 jin6 zau6 haak3 can1 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing deliberately scaring someone or frightening people in general.

example.english: Don't keep dressing up as a ghost to frighten people.
example.traditional: 你唔好成日扮鬼嚇人啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 baan6 gwai2 haak3 jan4 laa1

rows.note: Use this construction when describing the frightening effect on a particular person, often followed by that person's resulting state.

example.english: Those scenes frighten me so much that I can't sleep.
example.traditional: 嗰啲畫面嚇到我瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: go2 di1 waa6 min6 haak3 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6
